minemetal.options.upscaler.tooltip:
Renders the world at a lower resolution and scales it up to the window. The GUI stays at full resolution.
MetalFX Temporal: Apple's temporal upscaler - also anti-aliases (turn the shader pack's own TAA off). Works at 100% too, as pure anti-aliasing.
MetalFX Spatial: single-frame upscaling.
AMD FSR 1: edge-adaptive upscaling + sharpening.
Bilinear: plain scaling (for comparison).
minemetal.options.renderScale.tooltip: World resolution in percent of the window (per axis). 75% renders about 56% of the pixels. Only used when an upscaler is on.
minemetal.options.sharpness.tooltip: AMD FidelityFX RCAS sharpening applied after FSR 1 or MetalFX. 0% turns it off.
minemetal.options.shadowHalfRate.tooltip: Shader packs: renders the shadow map only every other frame and reuses it in between (aligned to the current camera). Shadows are usually the most expensive part of a shader pack, so this gives a large fps boost; shadows of moving mobs and swaying leaves lag one frame behind.
